title: Automated Data Export Pipeline
description: An event-driven AWS pipeline: a monthly EventBridge schedule triggers a Lambda function that reads database credentials from Secrets Manager, queries Amazon RDS inside the VPC, writes the result as a CSV to Amazon S3 and sends it out through Amazon SES. CloudWatch captures the logs and Amazon SNS raises failure notifications. The architecture shown is the diagram published in the repository.

title: AWS Multi-Account Health Check & Reporting
description: Automation that collects infrastructure and service information across multiple AWS accounts and turns it into scheduled reports: AWS Backup status, AWS Config resources, ACM certificate expiry, EC2 disk space, Personal Health Dashboard notifications, service limits, resource tagging, CloudWatch alerts and resource health checks, delivered by email through Amazon SES.
note: Professional work. Described on my GitHub profile; the code is not public.

title: AWS Cost Optimization
description: Cost optimization across AWS environments: EC2 rightsizing, EC2 and RDS start/stop scheduling automation, identifying underutilized resources, AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations, Savings Plans and resource utilization analysis. Result: AWS infrastructure costs reduced by approximately 60%.
note: Professional work. The ~60% figure applies to this initiative only.

title: Terraform Infrastructure Upgrade
description: Upgraded Terraform configurations across 15 repositories: Terraform version upgrades, configuration compatibility updates, deployment validation and infrastructure standardization, leaving the infrastructure code easier to maintain.
note: Professional work. The repositories are private.

title: Linux Secrets Manager
description: A Bash command-line secrets manager: user registration, username and password authentication with hidden password input, duplicate-username checks, file-based storage and input validation, built with grep and core Linux utilities.

title: Linux Log File Analyzer
description: A Python tool that reads an application log file and counts its ERROR, WARNING and INFO messages.

title: Power BI Sales Dashboard
description: An interactive Power BI dashboard for sales analysis that integrates data from multiple sources: KPI tracking, interactive reports and data visualization that let stakeholders make data-driven decisions. It contributed to a 15% improvement in sales forecasting accuracy.
note: The report lives in a private Power BI workspace, so there is no public link yet.

title: ATM Management System
description: A menu-driven Python ATM program with PIN authentication, balance checks, deposits and withdrawals.

title: Student Profile Management
description: A Python program that stores and processes student, course, batch and completed-skill information.

title: Password Validator
description: Checks whether a password meets defined security rules: 8 to 15 characters with uppercase, lowercase, digit and special-character requirements.

title: Email Validator
description: Validates an email address with string operations and conditional logic: exactly one @, a username of at most 15 characters, a dot in the address and no spaces.

title: Prime Number Checker
description: A small Python program that checks whether a number is prime using the modulus operator.

title: Online Shopping Cart
description: A Python shopping cart that adds, removes, searches and lists items through a menu.

title: Employee Record Management
description: A menu-driven Python program to add, view and search employee records by ID.

title: CSV Employee Record Management
description: Employee records stored in a CSV file: add, view and search by ID with Python's csv module.

title: Marks Management
description: Calculates subject-wise and total marks, separating internal and external marks, with nested dictionaries and loops.
